Hi Monica / Travel team —

We're finalizing travel for the Redwood Exec Roundtable in Denver (May 16-17). Attendees list is attached (attendee_list.csv). High-level constraints and asks:

- Arrival window: everyone should be on-site by 3pm MT on May 16. Prefer morning/early-afternoon arrivals where possible.
- Budget: standard economy for most; approvals for business for two execs noted below.
- Flexibility: refundable or rebookable fares preferred (we may need last-minute changes).
- Multi-modal: Evelyn will be coming via SF for a client call; please include a rail option (SLC->DEN or alternative) only if it shortens overall door-to-door time.
- Carbon preference: if difference in total travel time is <45 minutes, prefer nonstop or single-connection over multi-stop.

Particulars per attendee (from the attached sheet):
- Marcus Lin: earliest possible arrival (needs to be on property by 1pm). Please hold a business upgrade option for Marcus and one guest; include cost and approval path.
- Laura Bennett: flexible, prefers aisle seat.
- Evelyn Hart: routing via SFO on the 15th AM, needs a later return (May 18 evening).

Please send 3 hold options per attendee (nonstop if available, one-stop, and a rail alternative where it makes sense). Include PNRs, fare rules (refund/change fees), seat availability, and estimated total cost per person. Hold fares for 48 hours.

Thanks —
Naomi

Hi Naomi and team —

Thanks for the details. We pulled options and attached a summary (pnr_options_20270503.pdf). Highlights:

1) Nonstop / shortest door-to-door
   - SFO -> DEN nonstop (multiple morning flights on May 16; sample hold: UA 398, depart SFO 09:20, arrive DEN 12:10). Refundable premium economy upgrade available + seat maps.
2) One-stop (better pricing, similar arrival times)
   - LAX/SFO -> PHX -> DEN (1-stop, total ~5.5-6.5h)
3) Rail alternative (recommended for SLC-based travelers only)
   - SLC -> Amtrak (via Utah Transit) is significantly slower and not recommended for tighter arrival windows; however, we scoped a private shuttle option from SLC to DEN at premium cost that meets the 3pm arrival.

We have tentative holds on fares for 48 hours; holds and detailed PNRs are in the attached PDF. Fare rules: refundable for highest fare classes, most 2nd-tier fares allow change with fee.

Please advise which holds to confirm and which to release. If you authorize any business-class upgrades, we will mark those PNRs as pending and send approvals for signature.

Best,
